evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce FailBench, a benchmark for robot failure detection comprising 2,197 manipulation attempts across 14 public sources (12 real-world, 2 simulated).

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Performance depends heavily on required visual evidence: models approach saturation when outcomes depend on observable object motion, but degrade to near-chance (<0.60 balanced accuracy) on contact-intensive assembly tasks.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating 13 VLM-based detectors, we find the best model achieves only 0.77 mean balanced accuracy.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Notably, models fine-tuned for failure detection consistently underperform general-purpose VLMs and their own pretrained baselines.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate robot manipulation outcomes, but existing benchmarks offer limited evidence of cross-domain generalization.
